tweet.text: METR evaluated DeepSeek-R1’s ability to act as an autonomous agent. On generic SWE tasks it performs on-par with o1-preview but worse than 3.5 Sonnet (new) or o1. Overall R1 is ~6 months behind leading US AI companies at agentic SWE tasks and is only a small improvement on V3.🧵
